DESCRIPTION: Plaid is a financial data API connecting apps to users' bank accounts, covering payments, transactions, identity, and credit underwriting.
ACCESS_NOTES: Developers self-serve create a Dashboard account and immediately get Sandbox/Development API keys (client_id/secret). Production API access requires explicitly requesting approval via the Dashboard before using real bank data.
API_NOTES: Payments/transfers, transactions, investments, liabilities, identity/KYC, fraud monitoring, and credit/income underwriting endpoints.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Production access requires a separate approval request beyond initial signup.

DESCRIPTION: Plain is a modern B2B customer support platform with a GraphQL API for threads, customers, and tiers.
ACCESS_NOTES: GraphQL API with documented authentication guide, no gating found.
API_NOTES: GraphQL-only surface for threads/tickets, customers, and support tiers.

DESCRIPTION: Podio is a customizable work-management/CRM platform with an OAuth2-based REST API for apps, items, and workspaces.
ACCESS_NOTES: Registering an application to get a Client ID/Secret is a self-serve step on the official developer site; Podio itself has a free tier for up to 5 users, though exact API-specific pricing terms were not separately confirmed.
API_NOTES: Covers Podio's custom "apps"/items model, workspaces, and files -- flexible but centered on Podio's own generic data model rather than a fixed CRM object set.

DESCRIPTION: Pumble is a team chat app (by CAKE.com) offering an API-keys-based integration add-on for channel and messaging automation.
ACCESS_NOTES: API access is presented as an 'API Keys integration' add-on inside Pumble's help center rather than a standalone developer platform -- it was not confirmed whether this add-on is available on the free plan or requires a paid plan.
API_NOTES: Documentation found is limited to the API-keys integration help article rather than a full endpoint reference; breadth likely narrow (channel/message actions) but not fully confirmed.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Official developer documentation is thin (help-center article only); access-tier and full API breadth not confirmed.

DESCRIPTION: Pylon (usepylon.com) is a B2B customer support/customer-ops platform unifying Slack, Teams, email, and chat into one ticketing system with a REST API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Documented REST API at api.usepylon.com with self-serve key generation described in official docs.
API_NOTES: Knowledge base, accounts, contacts, and teams endpoints documented.

DESCRIPTION: QuickBooks Online is Intuit's accounting platform with a REST API for invoices, customers, payments, and accounting data.
ACCESS_NOTES: Developers self-serve create an Intuit developer account and get Sandbox OAuth2 credentials immediately, but multiple independent third-party integration guides (Codat's 'QBO app assessment questionnaire', Zuplo, Satva Solutions) describe a required app assessment/production review before an app can access real customer data. The official Intuit developer pages render via JavaScript and could not be directly fetched to confirm this firsthand.
API_NOTES: Invoices, customers, vendors, payments, items, and general accounting/reporting entities.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Production access to real customer data requires an app assessment/review process beyond initial sandbox signup.

DESCRIPTION: Ramp is a corporate card and spend-management platform with a REST API using OAuth2 client credentials for transactions, cards, and bill pay.
ACCESS_NOTES: Any Ramp account admin can self-serve create a developer app and OAuth2 client-credentials for their own organization's data. Building an app that connects to other Ramp businesses (ISV/partner distribution) requires a separate 'production access' application and Ramp approval.
API_NOTES: Transactions, cards, bill pay, and reimbursements, scoped via OAuth2 scopes; additional scopes available on request via support ticket.

DESCRIPTION: Reducto is an agentic document-understanding API for parsing, extracting, splitting, and editing PDFs and documents.
ACCESS_NOTES: Developers sign up for a free account at studio.reducto.ai and generate an API key immediately from the dashboard, with no manual approval step.
API_NOTES: Parse, extract (schema-based field extraction), split, edit, classify, and async parse with webhooks; SDKs available in Python, Node.js, and Go.

DESCRIPTION: Salesforce B2C Commerce (Commerce Cloud) is an enterprise ecommerce platform with the Shopper/Commerce APIs (SCAPI) and the legacy Open Commerce API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Unlike core Salesforce CRM, B2C Commerce has no free Developer Edition -- an API Client ID must be provisioned inside an existing Commerce Cloud instance (Account Manager), which requires being a paying B2C Commerce customer. This is an enterprise ecommerce product sold through Salesforce sales, not self-serve signup.
API_NOTES: Shopper Commerce API (SCAPI) covers products, baskets, orders, customers; the older Open Commerce API (OCAPI) is being deprecated in favor of it.
MAIN_BLOCKER: No public self-serve trial; requires an existing paid B2C Commerce Cloud org.

DESCRIPTION: Salesforce is a cloud CRM platform for managing sales, service, and marketing data, with a broad set of APIs for reading and writing org data.
ACCESS_NOTES: A free Developer Edition org (developer.salesforce.com/signup) gives immediate REST/SOAP/Bulk API access for building and testing, no approval needed. Caveat: for an existing production org, API access depends on the org's purchased edition (e.g. some lower editions require an add-on for API access) -- this is an org-level licensing detail, not a Composio integration blocker, since Developer Edition itself is unrestricted.
API_NOTES: REST API is the primary surface; OTHER covers SOAP API, Bulk API, Streaming/Pub-Sub API, Metadata API and Tooling API, which together reach essentially the full CRM object model (records, custom objects, Apex actions, Flows). Correction from an earlier draft that mis-tagged this as SDK_ONLY -- client libraries are convenience wrappers, not a separate access surface.

DESCRIPTION: SE Ranking is an SEO/rank-tracking platform with a REST API for keyword, project, and data-source endpoints.
ACCESS_NOTES: API access is tied to an SE Ranking subscription plan per the official 'Getting API access' guide; not a free-standing free tier.
API_NOTES: Data API (keyword/SERP/domain metrics) and Project API (rank-tracking project management) as separate documented products.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Requires a paid SE Ranking subscription for API access.

DESCRIPTION: SendGrid (a Twilio product) is a transactional/marketing email platform with a REST API for sending mail and managing templates/stats.
ACCESS_NOTES: API keys with scoped permissions are self-generated from account settings; free tier available.
API_NOTES: Mail send, templates, stats/analytics, contacts.

DESCRIPTION: Sentry is an application error-tracking/observability platform with a REST API for issues, events, and projects.
ACCESS_NOTES: Auth tokens are self-generated from account settings; Sentry has a free developer tier.
API_NOTES: Issues, events, projects, releases, and performance/tracing data.

DESCRIPTION: Sherlock is an open-source command-line tool that hunts for social media accounts registered under a given username across 400+ sites.
ACCESS_NOTES: Not a hosted service with a signup/access process at all -- it is an MIT-licensed CLI tool installed locally via pip/pipx/Docker. There is no vendor account, no API key, no rate-gated backend. 'Self-serve free' here means 'freely installable,' not 'self-serve API access,' which is why this record is routed to human review rather than auto-approved as READY.
API_NOTES: Single-purpose tool: given a username, checks 400+ sites for a matching registered account and prints/saves results. No other capabilities.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Not a company-backed API at all -- it's a locally-run open-source CLI with no vendor, no account model, and no company to partner with. A toolkit is technically possible (wrap the CLI/Docker image as a tool), but this doesn't fit Composio's usual 'call a vendor's API on a user's behalf' integration model, so a human should decide whether a CLI-wrapper toolkit is in scope before building it.

DESCRIPTION: Shopify is an ecommerce platform with Admin, Storefront, and several agent-facing MCP APIs for products, orders, carts, and checkout.
ACCESS_NOTES: Custom app access tokens are self-serve from any store admin; public-app OAuth distribution goes through the Shopify Partner program, also free to join.
API_NOTES: Admin API (products, orders, customers, inventory) plus a growing family of agent-specific MCP servers (Storefront, Cart, Checkout, Customer Accounts) -- one of the most AI-agent-forward ecommerce platforms researched.

DESCRIPTION: Slack is a team messaging platform with a REST API (Web API) for messages, channels, and users, plus a Developer Program for building apps.
ACCESS_NOTES: Creating a Slack app and generating tokens is self-serve via api.slack.com/developer-program, free for a workspace's own use; distributing an app publicly goes through app review.
API_NOTES: Messages, channels, users, files, and a large events/interactivity surface.

DESCRIPTION: Smartsheet is a spreadsheet-based work-management platform with a REST API for sheets, rows, and reports.
ACCESS_NOTES: API access tokens are self-generated from account settings; OAuth also documented for app developers.
API_NOTES: Sheets, rows, columns, reports, and workspaces.

DESCRIPTION: Snowflake is a cloud data warehouse with SQL and REST APIs, key-pair/OAuth authentication, and Cortex AI agent tooling.
ACCESS_NOTES: Free trial account with credits is self-serve; ongoing usage is consumption-priced (compute/storage credits), so sustained use requires a paid account.
API_NOTES: SQL API, key-pair/OAuth-authenticated REST endpoints, and Cortex AI/agent-specific APIs; OTHER reflects key-pair (JWT-based) auth alongside OAuth.

DESCRIPTION: Squarespace is a website/ecommerce builder with Commerce APIs for orders, products, and inventory.
ACCESS_NOTES: API keys are generated from account settings; a note in third-party sources mentions 'API access developer mode not available' in some cases, suggesting Commerce API access may require a specific Squarespace Commerce plan tier -- not fully confirmed from official docs.
API_NOTES: Orders, products, inventory, and website content APIs.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Possible plan-tier dependency for Commerce API access, not fully confirmed.

DESCRIPTION: Stripe is a payments and financial infrastructure platform that lets businesses accept payments, manage subscriptions, and move money programmatically.
ACCESS_NOTES: Anyone can create a free Stripe account and immediately get sandbox/test API keys and live keys after signup; no approval gate for API access itself. Stripe charges transaction fees on live payments processed, but that is a usage fee, not a developer-access gate.
API_NOTES: REST API at api.stripe.com covering payments, customers, subscriptions, invoices, payouts, tax, issuing, connected accounts, and more. Official client libraries in 7 languages.

DESCRIPTION: Supabase is an open-source Postgres-based backend-as-a-service with REST/GraphQL APIs (auto-generated) plus a Management API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Project API keys are available immediately on project creation, free tier included; Management API uses OAuth2 for third-party integrations.
API_NOTES: Auto-generated REST/GraphQL over the Postgres schema, plus Auth, Storage, and a Management API for provisioning projects.

DESCRIPTION: systeme.io is an all-in-one funnel/course/email-marketing platform for solopreneurs, with a public REST API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Public API key is created directly from account settings per the official help article; systeme.io has a free plan.
API_NOTES: A third-party review (thatmarketingbuddy.com) independently rated this API's agent-readiness 5/10, consistent with a smaller, less mature API surface than category leaders like Mailchimp/Klaviyo -- treated as a directional signal, not the classification basis.

DESCRIPTION: Telegram is a messaging app; the Bot API lets developers build bots that send/receive messages, and a separate Client API exists for full account automation.
ACCESS_NOTES: Any user can create a bot and get a token instantly via @BotFather, entirely free and self-serve, per official docs.
API_NOTES: Bot API covers sending/receiving messages, media, inline keyboards, and channel/group management -- broad for a bot-scoped interface, but bots cannot do everything a full user account can (that requires the separate MTProto Client API).

DESCRIPTION: The Threads API lets developers publish posts and read basic insights for a Threads account, built on Meta's Graph API pattern.
ACCESS_NOTES: Dev/test access to your own account is self-serve through a Meta developer app; broader access likely follows the same Meta App Review pattern as WhatsApp/Meta Ads in this dataset, not independently re-confirmed here.
API_NOTES: Publishing (text/image/video posts), replies, and basic insights -- a narrower surface than the established Graph API products.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Same Meta App Review uncertainty noted for WhatsApp Business and Meta Ads applies here.

DESCRIPTION: Twenty is an open-source CRM with REST and GraphQL APIs, positioned as a modern, self-hostable alternative to Salesforce.
ACCESS_NOTES: Open source and self-hostable at no cost; a hosted cloud version also exists. API/developer docs are public with no gating found.
API_NOTES: REST and GraphQL APIs plus webhooks, covering the core CRM object model (people, companies, opportunities, tasks, notes).

DESCRIPTION: Twilio is a programmable communications platform (SMS, voice, video, email) with a broad REST API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Free trial account with API keys available immediately on signup; account SID/auth token or scoped API keys both self-serve.
API_NOTES: SMS/messaging, voice, video, verify, and a large set of communications sub-products.

DESCRIPTION: Vercel is a frontend cloud/deployment platform with a REST API for projects, deployments, and domains.
ACCESS_NOTES: Auth tokens are self-generated from account settings, free hobby tier included.
API_NOTES: Projects, deployments, domains, environment variables, and teams.

DESCRIPTION: Vonage (part of Ericsson) is a communications API platform (SMS, voice, video, verify) with a broad REST API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Self-serve signup with API key/secret shown immediately in the dashboard; free trial credit available.
API_NOTES: SMS, voice, video, verify (2FA), and number management across a wide communications API suite.

DESCRIPTION: Waterfall.io is a B2B contact/company data API for prospecting, enrichment, and email verification.
ACCESS_NOTES: API key auth with sub-key management is documented, but the signup/pricing/free-tier terms were not confirmed from an official page in this pass.
API_NOTES: 13 documented endpoints for contact/company enrichment, prospecting, and email verification, supporting sync and async operations.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Access/pricing model not confirmed from official sources.

DESCRIPTION: WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) lets businesses send and receive WhatsApp messages programmatically, built on Meta's Graph API.
ACCESS_NOTES: Dev/test access is free and self-serve: create a Meta developer app, get a temporary access token and a free test phone number, send test messages immediately -- no approval seen for this tier. Production requires registering and verifying a real business phone number (official doc: business-phone-numbers/phone-numbers). That same official page explicitly frames Meta Business Verification as raising your phone-number cap (2 -> 20), NOT as a hard prerequisite to go live -- which conflicts with the widespread third-party claim that verification is mandatory. Separately, Meta's general platform App Review process for moving an app from Development to Live mode likely applies here too, but the specific official page for that (developers.facebook.com/documentation/mcp/... and related App Review docs) was login-gated during this research pass and could not be directly confirmed. Net: real gating exists between test and production, but its exact shape is not fully verified from official sources in this pass.
API_NOTES: Graph-API-based REST surface covering messaging (text/media/template messages), webhooks for inbound messages/status, phone number and WABA management, and Embedded Signup for onboarding customers.
MAIN_BLOCKER: Test-tier access is straightforward, but the exact production gating process (business verification requirements vs. general App Review) could not be fully confirmed from official sources -- the relevant Meta page required a login. Needs a human with Meta developer console access to confirm before committing to READY, FEASIBLE_WITH_SETUP, or GATED.

DESCRIPTION: WooCommerce is a WordPress ecommerce plugin with a REST API for products, orders, and customers on self-hosted stores.
ACCESS_NOTES: WooCommerce is free, open-source, and self-hosted (on WordPress). API keys are generated by the store owner directly in wp-admin -- there is no central vendor access gate, though each installation requires its own hosting.
API_NOTES: Products, orders, customers, coupons, reports -- full store object model.

DESCRIPTION: Xero is a cloud accounting platform with a REST API for invoices, contacts, bank transactions, and accounting data.
ACCESS_NOTES: Developers self-serve sign up for a free Xero account and register an app in the developer portal to get a client id/secret; a free demo company is provided for testing at no cost. Xero's own getting-started FAQ does not describe a separate vendor approval step for basic API access.
API_NOTES: Invoices, contacts, bank transactions, accounts, items, and payroll/practice-manager APIs.

DESCRIPTION: TranscriptAPI.com provides a REST API for extracting YouTube video transcripts, with search, channel, and playlist support.
ACCESS_NOTES: Developers sign up for an API key to make requests; some endpoints (e.g. RSS-based latest videos, channel handle resolution) are explicitly free with no key required, while core transcript extraction uses a self-serve API key.
API_NOTES: Single-domain focus: transcript extraction, video/channel search, playlist browsing, and channel handle resolution.

DESCRIPTION: Zendesk is a customer support/ticketing platform with a REST API for tickets, users, and help center content.
ACCESS_NOTES: API tokens are generated directly from account admin settings; well-documented self-serve developer program with a free trial account available for building integrations.
API_NOTES: Tickets, users, organizations, help center, chat, talk -- one of the broadest support-category APIs.

DESCRIPTION: Zoho Cliq is a team chat/messaging app in the Zoho suite with a REST API and bot/webhook platform.
ACCESS_NOTES: Self-serve OAuth app registration via the Zoho API console, same model as other Zoho products.
API_NOTES: Messaging, channels, bots, and webhook-based extensions.

DESCRIPTION: Zoho CRM is a sales/CRM platform in the Zoho suite with a REST API for leads, deals, contacts, and modules.
ACCESS_NOTES: Self-client / server-based OAuth apps are created directly in the Zoho API Console by any Zoho account holder; no approval step found for standard OAuth API access.
API_NOTES: Covers standard and custom CRM modules (leads, deals, contacts, accounts) plus bulk read/write and notifications APIs.
